storyBody: Amazing Grace Bible Church began in Glasgow and has grown into a Bible-teaching family with branches in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands and Nigeria, united by one vision and one grace.
believeBody: We are saved by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone, and that grace is abundant enough for anyone who comes. The Bible is our foundation, Jesus is our Saviour, and the Holy Spirit is our helper.
missionBody: To spread the Gospel of the Grace of Christ and raise disciples who are sound in the Word, alive in the Spirit, Christlike in character, and equipped to use their gifts, careers and passions for mission, in every nation God sends us to.
